_: Библия ролика: мир, герои (канон внешности + позы-вырезки), декорации (куски сцены с местом на столе), предметы. Визуальные поля — по-английски и без стиля (стиль — styles/<id>.json). Ключ ассета: <герой>/<поза>, <декорация>/<кусок>, prop/<предмет>. Размеры и координаты — в сантиметрах игрушечной сцены: y — вверх от пола сцены, z — к камере; карточка стоит нижним краем (anchor bottom). h — высота вырезки, aspect — ширина/высота (для генерации и заглушки). facing — куда смотрит фигура на карточке. hole — проём насквозь [x0, y0, x1, y1] в долях карточки (снизу слева): для заглушки; после генерации — измеренный по прозрачным пикселям картинки (свет и фигуры за проёмом ставятся по нему). cast: false — карточка не отбрасывает тень (источник света внутри неё: лампа, лампочка). ref: false — поза без листа героя в запросе (крупные планы рук: с листом модель рисует фигуру целиком). erase — подчистка вырезки после ключа: [[x0, y0, x1, y1], …] в долях вырезки (снизу слева) — стереть лишнее (провод лампы).
world: A provincial Russian town around 1908. Summer heat and dust by day, wooden one-storey houses with carved window frames, grey plank fences, birches, unpaved streets. Indoors: striped wallpaper, heavy portières, green baize desks, the first electric lamps beside kerosene ones. Clothing of the late Russian Empire: frock coats, high starched collars, pince-nez, bowler hats, calico kerchiefs, gymnasium uniforms (brown dress, black apron), lace and parasols for ladies, shawls for old women.

doctor.name: The Doctor
doctor.role: рассказчик: молодой врач, у которого почти нет пациентов
doctor.look: a young provincial doctor of about twenty-seven, slim and narrow-shouldered, clean-shaven except for a thin dark moustache he is clearly still growing, dark hair parted in the middle and smoothed with pomade, round steel-rimmed pince-nez on a black cord, an earnest boyish face trying hard to look stern and experienced; dark charcoal-grey three-piece suit, high starched white collar, narrow black necktie, a thin watch chain across the waistcoat, polished black boots

pacing.desc: walking in strict profile facing right, hands clasped behind his back, head slightly bowed, bored and lonely

seated.desc: seated in strict profile facing right on an invisible seat, upright and stiff, hands folded on his knee, face set in cold attentive composure. He sits on an invisible seat: NO chair, NO stool, nothing drawn under him (the armchair is a separate cut-out).

seated-pencil.desc: seated in profile facing right, legs crossed, leaning back with an affected relaxed air, tapping a pencil against the fingertips of his other hand. He sits on an invisible seat: NO chair, NO stool, nothing drawn under him (the armchair is a separate cut-out).

seated-frozen.desc: seated in profile facing right, rigid with panic, hands gripping the knees, eyes wide behind the pince-nez, mouth slightly open, about to leap up. He sits on an invisible seat: NO chair, NO stool, nothing drawn under him (the armchair is a separate cut-out).

standing-shout.desc: standing upright in profile facing right, having just leapt up, one arm stretched forward with an open palm, mouth open, shouting firmly

patient.name: The Patient (Misha)
patient.role: третий пациент; жена зовёт его Мишей
patient.look: a man of about forty-five, of middle height, inclined to stoutness, bald crown with a thin fringe of fair hair, a curly fair little beard, a sharp pointed nose, short-sighted pale blue eyes with twitching eyelids, an important yet slightly absent gaze, restless fingers; dark brown frock coat buttoned over a waistcoat, white shirt with a high starched collar and starched cuffs fastened with bronzed cufflinks, grey striped trousers, worn black boots
patient.home_look: the same man at home in summer: shirtsleeves with the cuffs rolled once, an unbuttoned waistcoat, braces, no frock coat, no collar

standing.desc: standing in three-quarter view facing left, holding a bowler hat against his stomach with both hands, embarrassed, blinking; only the figure, no door, no doorway, no wall drawn

seated.desc: seated in profile facing left on a bentwood Thonet chair (the chair is part of the same cut-out), hunched forward on the edge of the seat, eyes lowered, fingers of both hands bending and unbending in his lap

seated-up.desc: seated in profile facing left on a bentwood Thonet chair (the chair is part of the same cut-out), suddenly raising short-sighted, bewildered, smiling eyes, eyebrows lifted

seated-beard.desc: seated in profile facing left on a bentwood Thonet chair (the chair is part of the same cut-out), left hand raised to his face plucking at his curly little beard, troubled thinking face

seated-talking.desc: seated in profile facing left on a bentwood Thonet chair (the chair is part of the same cut-out), leaning forward, both palms open in a pleading gesture, speaking quietly and passionately

seated-handkerchief.desc: seated in profile facing left on a bentwood Thonet chair (the chair is part of the same cut-out), blowing his nose into a large white handkerchief held with both hands, eyes still fixed and staring over it

seated-wipe.desc: seated in profile facing left on a bentwood Thonet chair (the chair is part of the same cut-out), wiping drops of sweat from his bald skull with his sleeve, exhausted

seated-fist.desc: seated in profile facing left on a bentwood Thonet chair (the chair is part of the same cut-out), striking his chest with his fist, morbid triumph on his face

seated-pale.desc: seated in profile facing left on a bentwood Thonet chair (the chair is part of the same cut-out), white as lime, glassy bulging eyes fixed on someone in front of him; his near (left) arm is MISSING at the shoulder (it is a separate jointed piece), a small brass paper fastener marks the shoulder

arm-upper.desc: an isolated upper-arm piece: a short straight tube of brown frock-coat sleeve cloth, from shoulder to elbow, hanging vertically, rounded ends, a brass paper fastener at each end; NO body, NO head, NO hand

arm-fore.desc: an isolated forearm piece: brown frock-coat sleeve from elbow to wrist, hanging vertically, ending in a starched white cuff with a bronzed cufflink, a brass paper fastener at the top; the piece ends at the wrist — NO hand, NO body

arm-hand.desc: a pale hand with long yellowish fingers, hanging straight down, open palm, wrist at the top

seated-dead.desc: seated in profile facing left on a bentwood Thonet chair (the chair is part of the same cut-out), dead, the face calm and stern, eyes open and gazing straight ahead slightly upward, the near arm resting with the palm on the bend of the knee

head.desc: a large close-up cut-out of ONLY his head, neck and the top of his shoulders (a bust, no body, no legs), in profile facing left, filling the whole picture: bald skull with drops of sweat, curly fair beard, sharp nose, twitching eyelid, frightened short-sighted eye

head-abyss.desc: a large close-up cut-out of ONLY his head, neck and the top of his shoulders (a bust, no body, no legs), in profile facing left, filling the whole picture: white as lime, sweat on the bald skull, and the eye has sunk deep into the socket and become a small round empty black hole

hands-cobweb.desc: a close-up cut-out of ONLY two hands (no body, no face): plump pale hands with starched white shirt cuffs and bronzed cufflinks, the fingers bent and tangled in fine white cobweb threads stretched between them

hands-button.desc: a close-up cut-out of ONLY two trembling hands (no face, no legs) unbuttoning a brass button on a piece of dark brown frock-coat cloth, starched white cuffs at the wrists

at-window.desc: at home: seated on a bentwood chair in three-quarter back view facing right, an open book in his lap, not reading, looking up and to the right as if out of a window; only the man and the chair, no window, no wall drawn

on-bench.desc: at home at night: seated on a simple low wooden garden bench without a back (two legs and a plank), face lifted to the sky, a cigarette between his fingers; only the man and the bench

in-bed.desc: at night: lying on his back in a narrow iron bed with a white pillow and a patchwork blanket pulled to the chest, eyes wide open; the bed and the man are one cut-out, seen from the side

in-hammock.desc: after dinner: lying contentedly in a rope hammock slung between two small birches, hands on his belly; wearing the home look

woman-baby.name: Woman with a baby
woman-baby.look: a young townswoman carrying a swaddled baby in her arms, a vivid bright red calico kerchief tied under her chin, a simple white blouse, a long dark blue skirt and apron; the most saturated, warm colors of the whole procession

walking.desc: walking in profile to the right, carrying the baby

girl.name: Girl of seven
girl.look: a skinny girl of about seven, barefoot, freckles, a single ginger pigtail sticking straight out behind her head like a piglet's tail, a faded yellow cotton dress; bright but slightly less saturated colors than the woman with the baby

running.desc: running in profile to the right, one foot off the ground, pigtail flying

schoolgirl.name: Gymnasium schoolgirl
schoolgirl.look: a gymnasium schoolgirl of about fifteen in the brown wool uniform dress with a black apron and a small white collar, a long braid, a satchel of books on a strap; muted brown and black colors

walking.desc: walking in profile to the right, eyes down, carrying the satchel

lady.name: Proper lady
lady.look: a very well-dressed, very proper lady of about forty in a lilac-grey walking dress with a high lace collar and a narrow waist, a wide hat with a veil and grey feathers, gloves, a closed parasol; faded, almost colorless lilac-grey

walking.desc: walking in profile to the right with a stately step

old-woman.name: Old woman
old-woman.look: a small bent old woman with a deeply wrinkled face, a grey woollen shawl over her head and shoulders, a dark grey dress, walking slowly with a stick; nearly monochrome grey, the palest figure of the procession

walking.desc: walking slowly in profile to the right, bent over her stick

facing.desc: standing still and turned straight toward the viewer, looking directly out with calm, knowing eyes

wife.name: The wife
wife.role: зовёт «Миша!» с крылечка; видна только силуэтом в освещённой двери
wife.look: a woman in a long skirt and a blouse with puffed sleeves, hair in a bun

doorway.desc: standing in a doorway, one hand on the door frame, leaning forward to call out

yard-keeper.name: Yard-keeper
yard-keeper.look: a broad bearded yard-keeper (dvornik) in a long white apron with a brass badge on the chest, a peaked cap and high boots, holding a broom

walking.desc: walking in profile to the right, broom on his shoulder

stranger.name: Passing stranger
stranger.look: a thin travelling man in a checked travelling coat and a bowler hat, carrying a carpet-bag, one side of his face screwed up in a nervous tic

walking.desc: walking in profile to the right, carpet-bag in hand, face twitching

funeral.name: Funeral procession (imagined)
funeral.role: то, чего «не хватает» в процессии — только тенью
funeral.look: a horse-drawn funeral hearse of the 1900s with tall black plumes and a canopy, a horse in a black caparison, followed by mourners with bowed heads

hearse.desc: the hearse and horse moving to the right, in profile

mourners.desc: a small group of mourners walking to the right with bowed heads, one holding a wreath

dogs.name: Running dogs (thoughts)
dogs.look: three scruffy street dogs running one after another

running.desc: three street dogs running to the right in profile, one after another

office.name: Кабинет доктора
office.look: the modest consulting room of a young doctor in a provincial town, 1908, in the evening

stars.note: за стенами — пустота со звёздами-проколами: видна, когда стены падают

wall.desc: the back wall of the consulting room: dark olive-green striped wallpaper, a framed medical diploma, an anatomical chart, a small glass-fronted bookcase with medical books, and on the right a dark doorway

wall-left.desc: the left side wall of the same room: the same olive-green striped wallpaper, a tiled stove corner and a small mirror

wall-right.desc: the right side wall of the same room: the same olive-green striped wallpaper, a curtained window with dark night outside, a coat stand

floor.desc: painted herringbone parquet floor with a worn dark red rug in the middle

portiere.desc: a heavy dark wine-red velvet portière curtain with tassels hanging in a doorway, slightly drawn aside, darkness behind

armchair.desc: the doctor's worn brown leather armchair with a high rounded back and wooden legs, in profile facing right; plain upholstery — no straps, no belts, no hanging cords or tassels

desk.desc: a long, wide writing desk seen straight from the front, about twice as wide as it is tall: a green baize top, a pedestal of drawers with brass handles on the left and another on the right, an open kneehole between them

lamp.desc: an electric desk lamp of 1908 with a brass stem and a green glass shade

desk-set.desc: a writing set: a cut-glass inkwell, a dip pen on a stand, a blotter and a small stack of papers, front view

bulb.desc: a bare early electric light bulb with a carbon filament hanging on a twisted cord from the ceiling

stars-near.note: ближний слой звёзд без картона — параллакс, когда стены падают

window.name: Окно в доме пациента (летний день)
window.look: a small sunny room in a wooden house and the dusty summer street outside its window

street.desc: a quiet provincial street on a hot summer day seen straight on: wooden one-storey houses with carved window frames, birches, a pale hot sky, a dusty unpaved road, no people; only the outdoor view filling the whole picture — NO window frame, NO curtains, NO room interior around it

road.desc: dusty pale ochre unpaved road with ruts

fence.desc: a ground row: a long low grey plank fence with tufts of grass and dandelions along its foot, front view, very long and narrow

room-wall.desc: the inner wall of a room in a wooden house with faded floral wallpaper, a wide wall with a window in the middle: white-painted window frame, lace curtain half drawn; the window glass area is completely empty (chroma green) so the street behind shows through

geranium.desc: a red geranium in a clay pot

floor.desc: painted wooden floorboards, sunlit, a homespun striped runner rug

garden.name: Садик ночью
garden.look: a tiny garden behind a wooden house at night

trees.desc: dark night silhouettes of apple trees and lilac bushes painted in very deep blue and black, front view, long

house.desc: the corner of a wooden house at night with a small porch of three steps and a closed door; the door panel is completely empty (chroma green) so a light can show through; deep blue night colors

fence.desc: a picket fence at night in deep blue, front view, long and narrow

grass.desc: a ground row of tall night grass and burdock leaves in black and deep green, front view, long and narrow

floor.desc: dark night earth and trampled grass, deep blue-green

bedroom.name: Спальня ночью
bedroom.look: a dark bedroom in the wooden house at night

wall.desc: a bedroom wall at night with faded wallpaper in deep blue moonlight, a small window with a curtain and a pale moon, a chair with clothes thrown over it

void.name: Пустота (без стен)
void.look: infinite black space pierced with stars

screen.name: Экран теней (воображение)
screen.look: a backlit sheet of translucent paper, the stage for shadow puppets

dark.name: Тёмный стол (вставки крупно)
dark.look: a dark tabletop, only one object lit

question.note: «изобразить собой огромный вопросительный знак» — бумажный вопрос выезжает за доктором
